meta.name: work-with-pr
meta.description: Full PR lifecycle in a fresh task-owned git worktree: implement via the ulw-loop skill with mandatory evidence-bound manual QA → reviewer-readable English PR → verification loop (CI + Cubic, where Cubic is skipped only when its quota is exhausted) → merge by default → worktree cleanup. Decomposes one task into the smallest atomic, independently-mergeable PRs and builds the independent ones concurrently via one worktree per PR driven by parallel subagents or a team. Unbounded loop: any failing gate sends you back to fix-and-re-QA inside that PR's worktree. Use whenever implementation work needs to land as a PR. Triggers: 'create a PR', 'implement and PR', 'work on this and make a PR', 'implement issue', 'land this as a PR', 'split into atomic PRs', 'parallel PRs', 'work-with-pr', 'PR workflow', 'implement end to end', even when user just says 'implement X' if the context implies PR delivery.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 拆分开发任务为多个独立小改动,自动验证后逐个合并上线。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常要把开发任务变成多个独立小改动,逐个通过验证并合入主分支。
copy.tagline_en: Turn one dev task into small verified changes that merge one by one.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often turn dev tasks into small changes requiring individual review and merge.

howto.what: 在一个独立 git worktree 里跑完整个 PR 流程:用 ulw-loop 实现、做留证据的手动 QA、写英文 PR,过 CI 与 Cubic 校验,默认合并后清理 worktree。任务拆成最小原子 PR。
howto.when: 当你说“create a PR”“实现并提 PR”等关键词,或要求把实现作为 PR 交付时触发;即使只说“implement X”,只要上下文暗示 PR 交付也会触发。

howto.what_en: Runs the whole PR lifecycle in a fresh task-owned git worktree: implements via ulw-loop with evidence-bound manual QA, writes an English PR, loops on CI and Cubic, merges by default, then cleans up. Tasks split into atomic PRs.
howto.when_en: Triggers on 'create a PR', 'implement and PR' and similar, or whenever implementation work should land as a PR; even a bare 'implement X' triggers it when the context implies PR delivery.
